historical_basis: Read preserved attempt 4 and attempt 3 codegen reports and attempt 1 raw objdiff; attempt 2 failed-variant details supplied in handoff. Avoided declaration/condition/alias/register/early-object-phi retests.
compiler: GC/1.3 canonical -O4,p -lang=c, scheduling enabled; complete generated command is in commands raw evidence.

hypotheses.name: nested_state_call
hypotheses.hypothesis: Nested argument expression may alter preservation/evaluation of object across the state lookup and thus register allocation.
hypotheses.result: Event/object remain r30/r31; state passes directly via mr r4,r3, eliminating retail temporary move.

hypotheses.name: aggregate_event_first and aggregate_object_first
hypotheses.hypothesis: Scalar replacement of aggregate fields may assign virtual registers in a different order from independent scalar locals.
hypotheses.result: Both produce the original instruction sequence and register allocation.

hypotheses.name: reuse_event_for_state
hypotheses.hypothesis: Reassigning the dead event parameter to state may change coalescing and nonvolatile register priority.
hypotheses.result: No allocation correction; additional mr r30,r0 and mr r4,r30 transfer instead of direct mr r4,r0.

disposition: Restored original clearest reconstruction, unchanged from accepted base; independent NonMatching registration and split retained. No source or registration change is needed. Experiment sources are recorded only as strings in assignment evidence.
divergence: Canonical and relocation-strict objdiff remain 84.64286% at 112/112 bytes. Generated event/object allocation is r30/r31 versus retail r31/r30. Retail schedules mr r3,r4 at +0x08 and mr r31,r4 at +0x14 among prologue stores; generated stores first, then mr r30,r4 at +0x14 and mr r3,r30 at +0x18. Subsequent event/object uses inherit the register mismatch. All four relocation offsets, types, targets and addends agree.
relocation_comparison: Four R_PPC_REL24 entries at 0x1c, 0x2c, 0x3c, 0x50 agree by target name and addend 0. Raw ELF symbol indices differ and are not relocation target identity.
identical_objdiff_note: Canonical and strict modes were independently executed; their raw JSON is byte-identical because relocations already agree. SHA-256 of each is 4993f1b7d398610eb4c375afcbe109c4f49a4a2a49397d848bf02718bff55ccf.
